$description: Prompt-injection and low-quality-content heuristics for refresh.py. Codes are uppercase with underscores. Severity is one of info, warn, block. refresh.py scans text fields in source content against these patterns. Tuning happens via PR review.

prompt_injection_phrases.description: Case-insensitive phrase hits commonly used to coerce assistants into taking actions. One hit flags the wave; PR requires safety-review-ok label before merge.

code_fence_in_descriptive_field.description: Triple-backtick code fence or tool-invocation shape in descriptive fields.

low_quality_commit_message.description: Commit messages that are too short or obviously placeholder. Applied only to upstream commit messages.

url_scheme_block.description: Dangerous URL schemes anywhere in source content.

url_scheme_warn.description: Non-https URL schemes in text fields other than reference_url.
